Viet Business Information & Technology Joint Stock Company · Tax ID 0104478506 · Hanoi Department of Planning & Investment · Registered E-Commerce Platform — MOIT Common questions Contact FAQ How quickly do you respond to international inquiries? We respond to email and Zalo inquiries in English within 1 business day, often within a few hours during Vietnam office hours. For urgent matters, calling or messaging via Zalo, WhatsApp or Skype on +84 914 261 828 reaches our team directly. What languages do you support? Our international team supports English and Vietnamese. Email replies are provided in English by default for international addresses. Phone, Zalo, WhatsApp and Skype conversations can be handled in either language. Can I visit your office without an appointment? We recommend scheduling a short call or Zalo message before visiting so the right team member is available. Both offices, in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, are open Monday through Friday and Saturday mornings. Walk-ins are welcome but a brief notice helps us serve you better. Is the customer service free of charge? Yes. All inquiries about free business listings, search problems, incorrect information and feedback are handled at no cost. We only charge for paid services such as Listings Ads and Banner Ads, which are quoted on request. Which time zone do your office hours follow? Our office hours follow Indochina Time, ICT or UTC+7. Vietnam does not observe daylight saving time, so the time difference is constant throughout the year. For international callers, ICT is 12 hours ahead of New York (winter), 6 hours ahead of London (winter) and 2 hours behind Sydney (winter). Ready to talk?
